personality_one_liner: A practical, command-center dashboard built for deep-water monitoring with tactical readability and restrained aquatic accents.

spacing.rule: Dense but legible: use sm/md between related labels/values, and lg/xl between major sections to prevent clutter.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with dividers for high-contrast clarity on dense data screens.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism, as it reduces performance and tactical clarity.

screens.name: SignIn
screens.purpose: Simple local-account sign-in with clearly labeled demo credentials (mock auth).
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with heavy bottom-to-top gradient scrim (surface color to transparent). Centered login card at the bottom 40% containing pre-filled inputs and sign-in button.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Live Sensor Dashboard displaying pond name, connection state, last-updated time, and large sensor-value cards.

states.empty: No connection illustration with retry button
states.error: Server unreachable banner with manual refresh.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top: Sticky Header with Pond Name and live connection badge. Below Header: Last updated timestamp. Main Area: 3 stacked large KPI cards for pH, Temperature, DO. Each card shows the metric name, massive value in Rajdhani, unit, and a colored status chip (Safe/Warning/Unsafe/No Data). Bottom: Sticky Manual Refresh button.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Reading history showing timestamped records with a simple trend view.

states.empty: Empty state illustration: No historical data available.

screens.layout: Top: Segmented control to pick parameter (pH/Temp/DO). Middle: Simple trend line chart or bar representation (can be mocked with colored blocks if actual chart library is missing, or use a lightweight SVG chart). Bottom: Scrollable list of timestamped records.

screens.name: Alerts
screens.purpose: Alert history displaying timestamp, parameter, measured value, threshold/status, and message.

states.empty: Green checkmark icon / illustration: No active alerts. All systems safe.

screens.layout: List view. Each row uses surfaceSecondary background, left border colored by alert severity (Warning = Amber, Unsafe = Coral). Includes timestamp (muted text), parameter name, large value vs threshold text, and description.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Settings with connection test, Demo mode toggle, API address input, and read-only thresholds.
screens.layout: Form layout with grouped sections using dividers. Section 1: Connection (Local IP input, Test button, network warning text). Section 2: Mode (Demo/Real toggle, Demo badge). Section 3: Read-only thresholds list (labeled 'Demo thresholds – not approved').

empty_alerts.alt: Sensor module indicating no active alerts

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines. The app should feel like a tactical command center.
No glassmorphism. Use solid surfaceSecondary colors with 1pt borders/dividers to create elevation and structure.
Ensure 'Rajdhani' font is used for all large metric numbers and ensure tabularNums is set on Text components so the numbers do not jump around as they update.
Implement the gradient scrim over the SignIn hero image (Layer 0 = expo-image, Layer 1 = vertical gradient from transparent to 90% surface, Layer 2 = form content at the bottom 40%).
Sensor values must clearly show 'Demo mode' and 'not approved' if toggled. Use coral/amber appropriately for Warning and Unsafe states.
For the History Screen trend view, prioritize a simple, readable format without decorative animations.
Use Phosphor icons consistently (either all filled or all regular weight).
Avoid unnecessary animations to ensure metrics are easily readable.
